topic.readerProblem: Understand what Peec AI is, what it does and costs, and whether a daily AI-visibility tracker is worth buying for their team, using only the vendor's own current documentation.
topic.connection: Helps an AEOeye reader decide between a one-off AI visibility audit and a subscription tracker such as Peec AI, and explains what the tracker's numbers can and cannot tell them.

assessment: The page explains Peec AI's metrics, data-collection method, features, plan prices and fit from Peec's own pricing page, docs and AI-instructions page as read on 2026-10-03, adds a reliability caveat from SparkToro's repeated-run research and a take on who should skip it. It states up front that it is documentation-based and not hands-on. It does not claim hands-on use, data accuracy, a trial length (none stated on Peec's pages) or that Claude is available below Enterprise; detailed pricing arithmetic is left to the dedicated pricing page.

sources.supports: Brand plans (Starter $95 / Pro $245 / Advanced $495 monthly, 50/150/350 prompts, 1/2/5 projects, unlimited users, daily tracking, choose 3 models), Enterprise custom with API, SSO and more models, selectable model list, Perplexity add-on, 15% annual-billing FAQ, Start free trial CTA, 4,500 monthly AI answers on Starter, crawlability check across 40+ bots. Dollar amounts are JavaScript-rendered and were read in a real browser.
Agency plans Essential $245 / Growth $495 / Scale $795 per month on monthly billing, credits, trial CTAs, free pitch projects section. Read in a real browser (JavaScript-rendered).

Peec uses browser automation (UI scraping) not APIs, runs prompts daily, mirrors a logged-out user where the platform picks the model and whether to search, the three headline metrics, sources as the basis of metrics.
Definitions of visibility, share of voice, position, sentiment (0-100), prompt volume score 1-5, and brand visibility versus source visibility.
Actions grouped into Site audit, Owned and Earned; relative impact rating; separate Impact view measuring results after completion.
MCP server connects Claude, Cursor and other tools to Peec data; most tools read-only; write tools need organization-owner access and confirmation. Lists Claude among monitored engines.
AI referrals reads Google Analytics 4 sessions, conversions and revenue from AI assistants.
API access is currently limited to Enterprise customers.
AI often answers informational prompts without naming brands, so they surface fewer brand mentions.
Monthly plans end at the end of the payment cycle; 12-month plans need 30 days' notice at the end of the term with no automatic refund for early termination.
Dated July 2026: Berlin headquarters, product launched February 2025, 3,000+ customers (company claim), Peec does not generate or publish content by design, pursuing SOC 2 and not yet certified.

600 volunteers, 12 prompts, three AI tools, 2,961 runs; under 1-in-100 chance of the same brand list twice; author concluded visibility percentage across many runs is reasonable and ranking position is unreliable.
Defines generative engine optimization (GEO) as a framework for improving content visibility in generative engine responses.
